description:
SHIPPED s470bn (Opus, 2026-09-05), commit `cc83209`.  RUNTIME ONLY â no
PCL_OPT name, because there is no emission to switch (the way %p-vpush,
%p-vec-data and p-array-fill's capacity reserve have none).

`p-array-fill` did a full SNAPSHOT allocation and copy of the source, then a
per-element walk (a five-way cond, %p-array-store-scalar's tests, %p-vpush).
Both passes are avoidable when every element would be stored AS ITSELF.

THE LICENCE IS PER ELEMENT AND IT IS THE EXISTING WRITE RULE READ BACKWARDS:
%p-storable-raw is the ONE function that decides what an element slot may hold,
and it is ASKED (rule 11).  Legal for element E exactly when the general path
would store E itself: a hole (NIL), or a value %p-storable-raw hands back
UNCHANGED (a plain number, a plain string).  A BOX is copied into a FRESH box
(perl copies values); a nested vector / hash / flatten marker is FLATTENED â
which is also what makes skipping the aliasing snapshot safe, since the only
source that can contain PLACE is one containing a vector.  With *p-raw-elems*
off the predicate answers NIL for every value, so the fast path disappears with
the gate.

=== DONE (s470bn) ===
Hand-replaced A/B -72.3 % of the listcopy loop (control -0.2 %).  Shipped, as a
runtime A/B against an ee9a658 runtime (BENCH_RT_B, best-of-5, three rounds):
listcopy -52..-57 % (0.94x -> 0.41-0.47x of perl), sortnum -6..-11 %, sortstr
-3..-7 %; every other row inside the box's +-5 % noise band, none regressed.
Seventeen probe shapes identical to perl AND to the base runtime on the same
emitted CL.  Companion op/array.t 170/25, op/aassign.t 175/14, op/sort.t
183/22.  Guard `Pl/t/perf-levers-01.t`.
subject: the array-assignment BULK FILL: `@x = LIST` whose every element lands as ITSELF is one block copy (listcopy 0.94x -> 0.42x of perl)
